context: Daichi and Mei plan a southern road trip.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: travel planning; vocabulary (現地/高速/図書館/レストラン/南) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 南の町まで、高速で行こか。
lines.en: Let's take the expressway to the southern town.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 高速だと、どれくらいですか?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 南までやと、二時間ほどやな。
lines.en: To the south, about two hours.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 現地で、おいしいレストランありますか?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 現地のレストラン、海の幸が最高やで。
lines.en: The local restaurants have amazing seafood.
lines.style: enthusiastic Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 古い図書館も、見たいんです。
lines.en: I want to see the old library too.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 南の図書館は、建物がきれいやで。
lines.en: The southern library has a beautiful building.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 現地を、ゆっくり回りたいですね。
lines.en: I'd like to tour the area slowly.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm closing delivery throughout
